sections.skill: Understand what settings and deletion actually do

questions.prompt: You turned off "use my data for training." Does that mean your chats are not stored?

choices.text: No; chats are always stored forever
Yes; all settings mean the same thing
Yes; turning off training deletes everything
Not necessarily; storage may be a separate practice

questions.correct_answer: Not necessarily; storage may be a separate practice
questions.intro: Policies can be long and vague, so look for specific answers: "Do you use my conversations to train models?" "Can I turn that off?" "How long do you keep data?" "Can staff read it?" "What happens when I delete it?" If the answers are unclear, assume the less private option. Remember that settings protect only what they promise: turning off training may not stop storage, and deleting a chat may not remove copies kept for safety or legal reasons for a stated period. Minimizing what you share protects you no matter what the policy says.
